providerFacts.claim: Direct subscription customers and prices belong to the connected account; disconnect does not cancel existing subscriptions.
Schedule end_behavior release leaves the subscription running; cancel terminates it. Basil iterations multiplies the price interval.
Schedule cancellation invoice_now and prorate default true; no-new-final-invoice proof must explicitly set both false.
Updating only customer default does not replace a subscription default; retry counters can increase without a new Charge on hard declines.
Cancellation pauses automatic collection of existing open/draft invoices but manual collection remains possible, and pending items can affect another subscription.
Test-clock advance is bounded by the shortest subscription interval; connected-account support and actual behavior remain unverified here.
